_comment: Shared by test_rescue_no_journal.py and lua/test_rescue_no_journal.lua (07.11.2026, owner decision F-80, the path WITHOUT an open journal: pair_auto.tick / pair.lua tick with the kernel on the reserve per selected_policy). Sibling of rescue_stable_cases.json (the journal path). Inputs: the detector sees the reserve failed (reserve_failed; the primary is healthy unless primary_failed); the fake backend.health of the reserve answers reserve_health ("unknown" = None/nil; absent = true); the fake recovery_ready of the primary answers true when the stability asked for is <= ready_upto; events = failover ledger stamps relative to now (negative). Expected: dispatch = a pair_return attempt to the primary was dispatched; asked = the stability recovery_ready was asked for (null = never asked); probed = backend.health of the reserve was asked exactly once (the one fresh probe); state/reason = what the tick published when nothing was dispatched.

cases.name: hold_reserve: the detector says failed, the fresh probe is false, the primary 10 s stable: rescued (RESERVE-FAILED-PRIMARY-VERIFIED through the same attempt)
hold_reserve: proven failed, the primary 9 s stable: held on the failed reserve for now
hold_reserve: the detector says failed, the fresh probe is unknown: HOLD, the primary is not asked
hold_reserve: the detector says failed, the fresh probe is alive: observes, the primary is not asked
hold_reserve: a working reserve is never left, nothing probed, the primary is not asked (unchanged)
hold_reserve: the rescue ignores the damped return_hold (two failovers in the window)
hold_reserve: the budget is exhausted and the last failover is inside the cooldown: no dispatch, nothing probed
hold_reserve: both channels failed, the fresh probe of the reserve is false, the primary is not ready: held
healthy_primary: a working reserve is left after primary_stable (unchanged), nothing probed
healthy_primary: a failed reserve is left after rescue_stable without a probe (unchanged)
